note: Rewritten from the original description in Maiti and Saha (2000) "Description of two new species of termites (Isoptera: Insecta) from Assam, India" (Records of the Zoological Survey of India 98(Part 4): 89–97), the original in English; the original is a description of a n. sp., the alate recorded as "Unknown", with only the soldier and the worker. The heading of the soldier measurement table of the original (Table 3) is misprinted as Neotermes assamensis, but the entries in the table (including the rostrum length and the width at the head constriction) are in fact the measurements of the soldier of this species and have been used accordingly. The figure (Fig. 2 A–C), the type specimens and the collecting details have not been entered.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule straw yellow, darker at the head constriction and at the apex of the rostrum; body length 2.90—3.15 mm; head length including rostrum 1.10—1.26 mm, without rostrum 0.76—0.80 mm, rostrum length 0.42—0.46 mm; maximum head width 0.73—0.80 mm, minimum width at the constriction behind the antennae 0.43—0.48 mm, height of the posterior swelling of the head 0.26—0.34 mm, maximum head height 0.46—0.54 mm; antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2 and slightly shorter than or nearly equal to segment 4; postmentum length 0.18—0.21 mm, width 0.24—0.26 mm; pronotum width 0.30—0.34 mm, length 0.11—0.12 mm. Worker body length 3.00—4.10 mm, head width 0.88—0.92 mm, antennae 14-segmented. Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, pale brown at the head constriction, dark brown at the apex of the rostrum; antennae, pronotum, abdomen and legs straw yellow, the antennae darker. Vertex with a few microscopic hairs and, posteriorly, 1 pair of erect hairs. Body length about 2.90—3.15 mm. Head capsule (without the rostrum) pyriform, moderately constricted behind the antennal bases; basal third distinctly convex at the sides; width at the widest point less than twice the minimum width at the constriction; posterior margin broadly rounded with a very weak median notch; dorsal margin weakly concave in lateral view; posterior swelling of the head moderate. Rostrum nearly cylindrical, slightly longer than half the head length without the rostrum (rostrum length 0.42—0.46 mm, head length without rostrum 0.76—0.80 mm); basal swelling indistinct, with 1 pair of erect hairs on it, the apex of the rostrum with a few more hairs. Frontal gland and frontal gland duct distinct. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2 and slightly shorter than or nearly equal to segment 4. Labrum small, wider than long, anterior margin weakly convex and with microscopic hairs. Mandibles without an apical process or apical tooth, the edge of the molar plate irregular. Postmentum as long as wide, the sides nearly parallel up to slightly above the middle and then narrowing forwards, anterior margin nearly straight (length 0.18—0.21 mm, width 0.24—0.26 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped, more than twice as wide as long, narrower than the head (width 0.30—0.34 mm, length 0.11—0.12 mm); anterior margin weakly convex, without a median notch; posterior margin convex.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellow to dark brown, tinged with brown at the apex; labrum and antennae paler than the head; legs, thorax and abdomen white. Head, thorax and abdomen rather densely hairy. Body length about 3.00—4.10 mm. Head nearly spherical, wider than long (head width 0.88—0.92 mm, head length to the mandibular base 0.70—0.75 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 1 longest, stout and cylindrical; segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 smallest. Postclypeus divided into two equal halves by a median suture. Labrum wider than long, hairy, anterior margin convex. Left mandible with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth slightly shorter than the first marginal tooth, the first marginal tooth well developed with its posterior margin longer than the anterior, the second marginal tooth small; right mandible also with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth pointed and conical, nearly equal to the first marginal tooth, the first marginal tooth close to the apical tooth, the second marginal tooth small with a long posterior margin; molar plate stout and toothed. Pronotum saddle-shaped, hairy, much narrower than the head width (width 0.46—0.50 mm, length 0.14—0.16 mm), the anterior lobe and posterior margin shaped as in the genus; tibial apical spur formula 2:2:2; tarsi 4-segmented; abdominal tergites sparsely hairy, the sternites more densely so; cerci 2-segmented.
